Good to know

Questions
& answers

Where are you located?

We are in Al Rawda 2, Ajman, UAE. Open the map in the contact section for directions.

Is Ecosophy for ladies only?

Yes – Ecosophy Beauty Center is a premium ladies beauty center. Gentlemen are welcome at our separate Men Care Center.

How do I book?

Tap any “Book” button and WhatsApp opens with your treatment already written. You can also call or message us – our number is in the contact section.

Do prices include VAT?

Prices are in AED. Where a package is marked “excl. VAT” or “+ VAT”, 5% VAT is added at checkout.

How many facial sessions will I need?

Treatments like the FCL Peel give the best results as a course of sessions. Our specialists recommend a plan after your first visit.

Do you offer massages during pregnancy?

Yes – we offer a dedicated Prenatal Massage and a Postpartum Massage, 60 minutes each.
